issues.description: Constructor signature mismatch for StockIngredient: the problem statement and the solution expect a constructor StockIngredient(String, int, int), but the template provides only a four-parameter constructor StockIngredient(String, int, int, boolean). This will prevent students from instantiating StockIngredient using the 3-argument form (e.g., new StockIngredient(name, price, quantity)) as required by the exercise and by the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Add or restore a 3-parameter constructor StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity) in the template (either by overloading the existing constructor or by replacing it). Ensure behavior matches the intended validation/normalization (as in the solution) so student code and tests can instantiate StockIngredient with three arguments.
